description: This file declares the HwcTester class, which provides an interface for interacting with the Hardware Composer (HWC) AIDL in the Android graphics system. It includes methods for retrieving display IDs, drawing colors on displays, and managing display configurations and writers. The file also includes necessary headers and namespace definitions.

classes.name: HwcTester
classes.description: A class that provides an interface to interact with the HWC AIDL, including methods for display management and drawing operations.

methods.name: GetAllDisplayIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all display IDs.

methods.name: DrawSolidColorToScreen
methods.description: Draws a solid color to the specified display using its ID.

methods.name: GetDisplayConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves display configurations for a given display ID.

methods.name: GetDisplayActiveConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves the active display configuration for a given display ID.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Gets the ComposerClientWriter associated with a display ID.
